THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER SECTION 11 AND 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT, 1971, R/W. ARTICLE 215 OF CONSTITUTION OF INDIA,1950, PRAYING TO, INITIATE THE CONTEMPT PROCEEDINGS AND PUNISH THE ACCUSED PERSONS HEREIN FOR WILLFUL DISOBEDIENCE OF ORDER DATED 11.01.2023 PASSED IN WP.NO.100151/2022 (LA-RES) ANNEXURE-C, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS CONTEMPT PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, S G PANDIT, J., MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard Sri. Lingaraj Maradi, learned counsel for the complainant.

2. Learned counsel for the complainant would submit that the contempt petition is filed complaining disobedience of the order dated 11.01.2023 passed in W.P. No.100151/2022, wherein this Court directed the respondents to address the grievance of the petitioner by considering the representation dated 31.07.2021 bearing in mind Annexure-B enclosed to the writ petition and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
